fr_html: Le Président propose qu'on procède au vote sur le traitement à donner aux juges titulaires, réserve faite des frais de voyage. Quant aux autres parties de l'amendement de M. Hagerup, il y a plusieurs points sur lesquels il faut se mettre d'accord:
en_html: The President proposed that a vote should be taken upon the salary to be given to regular judges, reserving the question of travelling expenses. Concerning the other parts of M. Hagerup's amendment there were several points upon which an agreement had yet to be reached:
